title: CodeLine
responsibility: Shows complete source text with explicit clipping or wrapping and an optional caller-owned inspection control.

inputs.name: CodeLine.text
inputs.description: Required complete source text. The full untruncated text stays in the DOM and native hover title.

inputs.name: CodeLine.mode
inputs.description: Optional clip or wrap mode, default clip. Clip uses one ellipsized line; wrap preserves whitespace and wraps long tokens.

inputs.name: CodeLine.action
inputs.description: Optional snippet containing an existing inspection action; its callback, dialog and focus return remain caller-owned.

inputs.name: CodeLine.className
inputs.description: Optional feature classes, default an empty string.

outputs.name: CodeLine
outputs.description: Code text with its complete hover/accessibility content, explicit clip or wrap presentation, and optional adjacent inspection action.

errors.name: Caller content error
errors.description: Errors from supplied snippets propagate; this presentation component does not catch them.
